_comment: An EXAMPLE catalog, not a published one. The digests below are zeros and no key has signed it.
A real index needs two things we cannot fabricate here: the sha256 of each GGUF as actually
published, and a signature from a key whose public half users are told to trust. Shipping a
file with invented digests would fail on first use, and shipping a placeholder signing key
would be worse than shipping none.
Publish one with: panday models sign <index.json> (docs/18 M18.2), and point clients at it
